product.name: Book Club Social App
product.tagline: Find or create local and online book clubs; share reads, polls, and monthly meeting notes

sections.problem_statement: Avid readers in India struggle to find high-quality, local, or niche-interest book clubs, often relying on fragmented, disorganized WhatsApp groups that lack structural reading engagement. Existing platforms like Goodreads or Meetup are either too global/impersonal or lack the specific features required to facilitate monthly meeting notes and structured discussions. This product uniquely centralizes the discovery, scheduling, and community-led discussion experience into a single, cohesive social ecosystem tailored for the Indian reading community.
target_users: Ananya, Corporate Professional, IT sector, struggles to find like-minded readers in her high-rise apartment complex for consistent discussions.
Rohan, University Student, Liberal Arts, wants to join niche genre-specific clubs (e.g., Dalit Literature or Sci-Fi) beyond his immediate campus circle.
Priya, Homemaker & Bookstagrammer, struggles to keep track of reading progress and meeting minutes for her large, dispersed virtual book club.
user_stories: As an Ananya, I want to filter clubs by my city and genre so that I can find offline meetups within a 5km radius of my home.
As a Priya, I want to create recurring poll templates for 'Book of the Month' selections so that I can eliminate manual coordination and reduce group fatigue.
As a Rohan, I want to upload monthly meeting summaries as structured posts so that members who missed the session feel included and updated.
As a club admin, I want to set a 'Member Limit' and 'Approval Queue' so that I can curate the quality of discourse in our private sessions.
As a user, I want to sync meeting dates to my Google/Apple Calendar so that I don't miss scheduled book discussions.
mvp_features: Geolocated Discovery: A map-based interface to find local clubs based on proximity and specific reading genres.
Club Dashboard: Centralized hub for club members to view current book, upcoming meeting dates, and past meeting notes.
Polling Engine: In-app voting mechanism for selecting the next book, ensuring democratic decision-making.
Structured Discussion Threads: Threaded comments under specific chapters or books to keep conversations organized vs. chaotic group chats.
Member Profiles: Profiles highlighting 'Books Read', 'Current Reads', and 'Favorite Genres' to foster community trust.
Notification Engine: Automated reminders for upcoming meetups and poll deadlines to maintain high active participation.
future_features: In-app Video Integration: Zoom/Meet API integration for seamless virtual sessions.
Author Q&A Sessions: Verified author profiles to facilitate exclusive AMA events for larger clubs.
E-commerce Integration: Affiliate links with platforms like Amazon/Flipkart to purchase the 'Book of the Month' directly.
Gamified Badges: Achievement system for hitting reading milestones to drive long-term retention.
success_metrics: Monthly Active Users (MAU): 10,000 active users within 6 months — measures the overall adoption of the community platform.
Retention Rate: 40% Day-30 retention — indicates the value of consistent club membership.
Poll Participation Rate: 60% of members voting in monthly selections — indicates high engagement in club governance.
Clubs Created: 500 active clubs with at least 5 members each within 6 months — measures the growth of the community supply side.
assumptions: Users prefer structured, organized discussions over chaotic messaging apps like WhatsApp or Telegram.
The Indian urban market has a high enough density of readers to support local, city-based meetups.
Users are willing to use a secondary app if it removes the 'coordination friction' of book clubs.
risks: Platform migration friction (users staying on WhatsApp) → Focus on unique value-add features like note-taking and polls that WhatsApp cannot do.
Data Privacy (DPDP Act compliance) → Implement robust user data consent management and strict access controls for private club data.
Low engagement/Ghosting → Use automated nudge notifications and gamified streaks to encourage participation.
sections.go_to_market: Launch via a 'Campus & Community Ambassador' program in major metros (BLR, DEL, MUM) to seed the first 50 clubs. Utilize Bookstagram and influencer partnerships to drive organic sign-ups. The first 100 customer playbook focuses on hyper-local growth by onboarding existing WhatsApp group admins onto the platform.
sections.tech_stack_suggestion: Build using a No-Code stack like FlutterFlow for the frontend and Firebase for the backend to allow rapid iteration. Use Supabase for database management and SendGrid for automated email/push notifications. Integrate Google Maps API for geolocation and Clerk for secure user authentication.
sections.monetisation: Freemium model with a 'Pro' tier at ₹499/year for advanced features like unlimited polls, custom club branding, and exclusive author events. Revenue is primarily driven by club admin subscriptions and potential affiliate commissions from book sales. Future expansion includes sponsored 'Book of the Month' placements for publishers.
